note: PinpointFinal narration. Narrator af_heart; the user's spoken notes use am_michael with a light phone-mic EQ. 'at' is seconds, or an anchor into the recordings ('walk.on@0.5' = mark + offset, 'scene:proof@0.9' = scene start + offset); build-audio-final.mjs resolves anchors from layout.generated.json, measures each line, and writes captions.generated.json. 'caption' is the short burned-in text (omit for none).
